$comment: Tool-usage benchmark for halo-scan. `toolsets` are named allowlists; `baseline19` is the toolset before the shortcut tools landed, `original10` the first commit. Names no longer registered (imports_of, recent_focus, manifest_summary, doc_toc were culled/merged) are skipped with a warning so the historical baselines still run. `full` means every registered tool. Question `repos` restricts a question to named repos; omit it for repo-agnostic questions.
$commentBaselineOptions: Options added to pre-existing tools alongside the shortcuts. They are stripped from the schema when running a non-full toolset so the baseline is honest.
